allocation.rule: N_l ~ h_l^3.25 within a run (Beskos 2017 Sec 3.3 with beta=4: sensor error ~h^2; zeta_h=2.5: sparse 2D solve ~ elements^1.25); N_0 x4 per added level (alpha=1 scaling, for a graded cost axis)

timing: Warm-cache conditional-on-initial-population benchmark; independent eta0 rejection initialization, reference and Figure4 excluded. Sampling + fixed-phi estimator evaluation included.

timing_profile.pde_seconds: Complete log-density calls: coordinate transforms, FEM assembly/solve, likelihood; not pure linear-solver time. Excludes observable evaluations.
timing_profile.pde_reweight_seconds: Initial SMC log density plus densities used for reweighting or LightSB cached ratios.
timing_profile.pde_mcmc_seconds: Proposal log-density calls inside MCMC, including rejected proposals.
timing_profile.fit_seconds: LightSB model and optimizer initialization plus all optimizer updates; no PDE calls.
timing_profile.propagation_seconds: LightSB uniform parent selection and conditional child sampling.
timing_profile.resampling_seconds: SMC/MLSMC weighted ancestor selection and population/log-density copies.
timing_profile.mcmc_total_seconds: Inclusive mutation time: OVERLAPS pde_mcmc_seconds. Do not add to the partition.
timing_profile.sampler_other_seconds: Remaining sampler wall time, including unclassified checks/copies and timer overhead.
timing_profile.partition: sampler_seconds = pde_seconds + fit_seconds + propagation_seconds + resampling_seconds + mcmc_other_seconds + sampler_other_seconds (up to timing roundoff).
timing_profile.per_level: diagnostics[].timing_breakdown covers each transition. Initial density/observable work precedes those transitions and is in run totals only.
timing_profile.overhead: Profiling has overhead; no timing calls are added inside the Adam update loop. Console/file output is outside recorded timers. CPU-only.

pde_work: Actual FEM forward counts weighted by number of elements, in common units across L. Continuum observable/reference work logged separately.

light_importance.interpretation: Optional fixed-cloud optimizer warm-up ending at beta=1; NOT SMC tempering. Global minibatches target the full-cloud empirical measure, not a guaranteed posterior. One transport per PDE level; final raw ESS always retained.

light_whitening.interpretation: Per-level affine whitening from the unweighted source cloud; LightSB (epsilon, S, r) operates in whitened units; children mapped back to z. init='identity': S=identity_scale(eps), r=(1-S)*anchor. correction='is': children weighted by gamma_l/q_l with q_l the exact LightSB mixture marginal, paired self-normalised correction, then multinomial resampling; extra level-l solves for every child are counted in FEM work.

estimator: Same continuum phi at all levels. LightSB unweighted pairs; MLSMC equation (5); SMC final mean.
